name: ai-resume-analyzer
description: An intelligent resume analysis and mock interview platform designed to help candidates prepare for product-based company interviews.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "cd python-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && cd python-service && uv pip install -r pyproject.toml
